He cut one rope and left me. I got up beside the cedar and picked up her small dagger. She had dropped it there. I pushed it into my own chest. The bushes around me grew quiet. Someone came slowly towards me on silent feet. A hand I could not see quietly pulled the dagger from my chest. I sank into the darkness and never came back.
